mentions.name: MAML
mentions.description: MAML is a JSON/YAML configuration language with a strict specification and 100% coverage, plus a reference implementation written so that reimplementing the parser in another language requires only a single prompt.
mentions.problem: Wanted a JSON/YAML configuration language for projects that comes with a strict specification.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://maml.dev

I wanted to make JSON/YAML configuration language for my projects. And i wanted a strict specification. This is want i created, now with specification and 100% coverage, reference implementation it’s just one prompt to reimplement parser in another language.
